summary: A story has more text than its frames hold, so the rest does not print.
Text uses a font that is not available here, so it is drawn with a substitute.
Characters are drawn as their font's missing glyph because the font lacks them.
A placed graphic's file is missing, so it prints as an empty frame.
Text uses a typography feature this build does not compose yet, so it may differ from the original.
A placed image in a print document has fewer pixels per inch than print needs at its placed size.
A text frame holds no text; removing it changes nothing on the page.
A print document uses an RGB swatch, which a printer converts unpredictably.
